szenen.vo: Jede Nacht verschenken deutsche Fabriken Strom im Wert von Millionen.
szenen.bild: Wide view of a modern German factory campus at night: clean flat-roof halls with glass fronts, LED-lit interiors glowing warm, a tidy parking lot, wind turbines far on the horizon, crisp cool night sky.
szenen.motion: Slow gentle push towards the glowing hall, interior lights flicker subtly, thin clouds drift.

szenen.vo: Die Maschinen stehen still – aber der Zähler läuft weiter.
szenen.bild: Inside a modern spotless production hall: current-day CNC machining centers and a fiber laser cutter standing idle in half-dark, blue standby LEDs, one bright digital electricity meter panel glowing on a column, clean epoxy floor reflecting the light.
szenen.motion: Camera glides slowly along the idle machines, standby LEDs pulse softly, the meter display flickers.

szenen.vo: VoltArc speichert günstigen Nachtstrom direkt in Ihrer Halle.
szenen.bild: A sleek white modern battery storage cabinet, size of a large wardrobe, being rolled on a lift trolley into the clean hall by two technicians in modern grey-orange workwear, bright even lighting.
szenen.motion: The technicians roll the cabinet into place, one steadies it, subtle camera follow.

szenen.vo: Und tagsüber, wenn Strom teuer ist, läuft Ihre Produktion aus dem Speicher.
szenen.bild: The modern hall in bright daylight production: robotic arm loading a CNC machine, a worker with tablet supervising, the white battery cabinet standing at the wall with a calm green charge indicator.
szenen.motion: The robotic arm moves precisely, the worker taps the tablet, the charge indicator breathes green.

szenen.vo: Bis zu vierzig Prozent weniger Stromkosten – installiert in sechs Wochen, ohne Umbau.
szenen.bild: Golden morning light outside the hall: two engineers in workwear and a manager shaking hands beside the delivered white battery cabinet on a small truck lift, modern facade behind them.
szenen.motion: The handshake completes, warm light rises, the truck lift lowers slightly.
